name: rule_engine_modernization
task: A deterministic rule-engine modernization pipeline produces incorrect reference digests. Trace the utility kernels and repair every root cause. A range fold must use its documented initial accumulator, and the smoothing kernel must use the sample two positions ahead when combining its window. Preserve public interfaces, pipeline order, configuration values, and unrelated arithmetic. Build the project; an independent evaluator will verify the complete correctness suite.
